page.overview:
Who is Ansel Meschsloffen?

Ansel Meschsloffen was a notorious tomb robber active in the Border Princes, Tilea, and even the Southlands.

Something of a celebrity in his lifetime, Meschsloffen was famed for his daring exploits delving into ancient vaults and Nehekharan tombs. His career ended suddenly and infamously when he succumbed to a deadly plague in a tavern in the Border Princes, bringing death to himself, his audience, and ultimately the establishment that housed him.

Ansel Meschsloffen made his name as a tomb robber, plundering ancient burial sites across the Border Princes, Tilea, and the Southlands. His actions were often condemned as desecration, yet his tales of danger and treasure captivated audiences. He became known for regaling crowds in taverns with vivid accounts of his adventures, frequently displaying strange gold coins as proof of his exploits.

Though many disapproved of his trade, Meschsloffen's charisma and storytelling made him popular among common folk, who would gather in great numbers to hear him describe deadly traps, skeletal guardians, and the riches he claimed to have stolen from Khemri's forgotten tombs.
